selected_gate.label: Voicemail action-only behavior
selected_gate.why: It is the smallest remaining English product-policy gate after autonomy: one known voicemail case, explicit owner feedback, and no regulated knowledge or broad classifier expansion.
selected_gate.risk: Could make the runtime take inappropriate same-loop actions after voicemail detection or blur message-taking versus selling behavior.
selected_gate.review_question: No new review needed unless the probe finds ambiguity in action-only voicemail behavior.
selected_gate.recommended_probe_scope: synthetic English voicemail action-only policy examples only
selected_gate.source_owner_feedback: if we reach a voicemail the agent should log this for another time and try again. The agent doesn't need to say anything to the voicemail
selected_gate.candidate_action: Do not speak to voicemail. Log follow-up and try again later according to campaign rules.
